description: CMS Medicare inpatient hospital averages per MS-DRG (data.cms.gov, fee-for-service Part A): hospital name, state, DRG code and description, discharges, average submitted charge, average total payment and average Medicare payment. Hospital-level averages, not the IPPS national rate table. Filter by 3-digit DRG code and optional state; up to 20 rows. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_medicare_advantage_star when you need official CMS Medicare Star Ratings for Medicare Advantage.
